speaker: john_heminges
text: Nine. The king this afternoon, and the shape of him this morning. You are in it.

speaker: will_kemp
text: You. I have said you before. I am not opening a new sorrow about a part I already know the size of.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Then we run the morning as the afternoon will have to stand. No new sentence in the doorway of a play we have already played.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am in the king. I am not rewriting him before dinner. The sheets in my sleeve are not his.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Keep them in the sleeve until the ordinary. A rehearsal is a short instrument. Do not make it a reading.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Dinner is at the Jackdaw, not here. This hour is the king. Be in it, and be done.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: In it. The afternoon can have the playing. I am not spending the morning on a speech he does not say.
